build_linear_crf_model: build a linear-chain CRF model with unary potentials and bigram transition graphs using gtn
create_transition_graph: create a bigram transition graph for a CRF with a given number of output classes
create_potential_graph: create a unary potential graph mapping input features to output classes for a CRF
sample_crf_model: sample sequences from a trained linear-chain CRF model using Viterbi decoding and graph composition
compute_crf_loss: compute the negative log-likelihood loss for a CRF given input and target sequences with potentials and transitions
